title.value: A BILL FOR AN ACT RELATING TO ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION
title.provenance: HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES THIRTY-FIRST LEGISLATURE, 2022 STATE OF HAWAII H.B. NO. H.D. 1 S.D. 1 C.D. 1

date.provenance: SECTION 3. This Act shall take effect on July 1, 2022.

pfas_definition.provenance: Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) means all members of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: Prohibit the manufacture, sale, or distribution for sale or use of wraps and liners, plates, food boats, and pizza boxes that contain PFAS; and Prohibit the manufacture, sale, distribution, and use of class B firefighting foams that contain PFAS, with certain exceptions.

exceptions: manufacture, sale, or distribution of class B firefighting foam where the inclusion of PFAS chemicals is required by federal law or regulations

intentionally_added.provenance: Intentionally introduced means deliberately utilized PFAS in the formulation of a package or packaging component where the continued presence of the PFAS is desired in the final package or packaging component to provide a specific characteristic, appearance, or quality.
